newsitem.title: USA: First Sierra closes Universal purchase.
newsitem.headline: First Sierra closes Universal purchase.

text.p: First Sierra Financial Inc said Thursday it had closed its acquisition of Universal Fleet Leasing Inc, the latest in a series of purchases made by the company since July 1996.
"(The) acquisition will give us a base from which to grow our vendor programs in our home state," it said.
Universal, a ticket lease company in Houston, generated lease volume of about $15 million in 1996 with an average interest rate of about 15 percent, it said.
First Sierra, a financial services and asset management firm, did not say how much it paid for the acquisition and officials were not immediately available for comment.
The company launched an initial public offering of two million shares in early May.
In early trading Thursday, its stock was 3/8 higher at 9-7/8, compared with its high of 10-1/8.
